long_biography.plain_text:
Manchester's Commonwealth Games gave media executive Charles Allen a second arena for large-scale organisation. He chaired the 2002 event, then joined the London 2012 bid and organising teams and served as mayor of the Olympic Village. His contribution to the Games led to a knighthood.

Allen now chairs the Invictus Games Foundation, which uses international sport to support wounded, injured and sick service personnel and veterans. The foundation also develops programmes beyond each competition, including community support and recovery initiatives. Alongside the foundation, Allen holds business chairmanships and sits in the House of Lords as Baron Allen of Kensington.
